description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the domain layer of an ASP.NET Core project, representing an article entity with properties such as slug, title, author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with metadata, author, comments, tags, and favoriting information.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has been favorited (i.e., any favorites exist).

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tag identifiers associated with the article.
